The workbook generation failed due to #NAME? errors in the statistics matrix, indicating invalid Excel formulas or missing named ranges.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -1.7216, got #NAME?). While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics formulas are broken. Avoid using unsupported Excel functions or uninitialized named ranges in the openpyxl workbook.
